title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.8
subtitle: A smaller, clearer New Look viewport toolbar.

highlights.title: Show or Hide with F6
highlights.description: Use F6 to temporarily hide or restore the New Look toolbar. Edit the shortcut in Cloth NeXt Preferences using Blender's native keymap controls.

highlights.title: Reliable Scene Status
highlights.description: The cache directory stays in sync when you add another deformable, while BAKE clearly shows when the scene is not ready.

highlights.title: Compact and Readable
highlights.description: The smaller toolbar keeps controls easy to use, shows errors in red, and restores its icons and labels after opening a saved scene.
